<thought>To obtain all possible precursors, I will apply retrosynthetic template 1914396 to the product SMILES extracted from the mapped reaction. The product SMILES is the string after the ">>" in the mapped_rxn. Using the apply_template tool will return the list of precursor SMILES combinations.</thought>
<action>apply_template</action>
